title.en: The path with the fewest steps

hints.en: In BFS, `for neighbour in sorted(graph[node]):`; if not in `parent`, `parent[neighbour] = node`.
`None` if the goal is not in `parent`; otherwise `path = [goal]`, append the parents, `path[::-1]`.
